# relates to frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:relatesToFrame`](gmeow-relatesToFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/relatesToFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

Relates a narrative reference frame to another narrative reference frame with which it stands in a relationship (the nature of which is given by [`gmeow:hasNarrativeFrameRelation`](gmeow-hasNarrativeFrameRelation.md)). Non-functional: a frame may relate to many others, and competing relation claims coexist. Flat shortcut; promote to [`gmeow:NarrativeFrameLink`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativeFrameLink.md) when the binding between source, target, and relation type must be explicit.

Use [`gmeow:relatesToFrame`](gmeow-relatesToFrame.md) from [`gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativeReferenceFrame.md) to [`gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativeReferenceFrame.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
